note: The French Southern and Antarctic Lands have no permanent population; every visit, French citizens' included, needs the territory's own authorisation (taken as a visa). Légifrance answers this client with a bot challenge, so the orders are read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of Overseas France
sources.said: Visits to the French Southern and Antarctic Lands and to Clipperton Island require specific authorizations.
